player_prompt.intro:
Unemdlalo weTower of Hanoi netidiskhi {num_disks}.
Ninabafuna kubaleka tidiskhi kusuka iTower A kuze kube iTower C.
Ukubaleka disk, xoxa igadi lesisuka neligadi lelinye (e.g., '[A C]').
Kumbula kwawukuthi ungasabaleki disk yekucala yegadi, futhi disk enkulu ayikho ingalibalekwa phezulu kwenye disk encane.
Kuleli kushesha, nika umkhuba mnye.

invalid_move.invalid_tower: Uchaze kutsi lomtfombo nobe umbhoshongo awusebenti.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Wetama kufaka idiski lenkhulu kulelinye lelincane.

outcome.win: Siyakuhalalisela, sewuyixazululile imfumbe ye-Tower of Hanoi.
outcome.turn_limit: Umkhawulo wekugucuka sewufinyelelwe. Ufake kahle {pct}% wema diski kuNqaba C.
